messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy 2026-09-12T15:04Z: release v1.14.0 -> prod (service: inference-gateway). Canary 10%. Commit: abc1234. Run: https://ci.internal/runs/9876
maya: Noted, watching logs. Change window ends 16:00 UTC.
liam: Seeing spike in 503s from inference-gateway during canary. Rolling back? :eyes:
maya: deploy-bot paused rollout automatically (healthcheck failed). Can we check helm overrides? staging looked fine earlier.
ash: I pulled values. Staging had `gateway.persistence.enabled: true` and `featureX.toggle: true` but prod helm release had an extra override file that set `featureX.toggle: false`.
liam: That's the mismatch. Suggest pinning image to sha for rollback, and revert the override.
maya: logs:
```
E0821 15:05:12 health.go:47] probe failed: 503 unhealthy response from /healthz
2026-08-21T15:05:13Z inference-gateway 503 GET /v1/stream
```
ash: Prod overrides (excerpt):
```
# prod-overrides.yaml
featureX:
  toggle: false
gateway:
  replicas: 4
```
ash: Staging values (excerpt):
```
featureX:
  toggle: true
gateway:
  replicas: 2
```
eva: Where did the prod override come from? I don't see it in the release branch.
liam: The ops-team changed global helm override in infra-helm repo last week to enable canary autoscaler; they added a prod-overrides file and forgot to align feature flags.
maya: OK, plan: 1) pin prod to image abc1234 (current canary sha) 2) revert/unapply prod-overrides featureX.toggle to true 3) redeploy canary in 10 minutes 4) postmortem with infra-helm owner.
ash: I'll open the rollback PR and add a note in release notes + rollback command: `helm upgrade inference-gateway ./chart -f prod-overrides.yaml --set featureX.toggle=true --reuse-values --namespace prod`
deploy-bot: Rollout paused by healthcheck. Rollback candidate created: https://git.internal/pr/4201
eva: tagging oncall and infra-team. @infra-team can you check the override provenance?
maya: adding to change window doc and will update release notes. :+1:
liam: After revert, let's add a check in the smoke test to assert featureX.toggle matches expected config across envs.
eva: agreed — we should also add a lint that flags feature toggles present in prod-overrides that don't exist in chart values.
maya: thanks team. I'll coordinate the PR and ping when ready for redeploy.
liam: TY. keeping monitor open.
